owner_posts.post_text: Anxiety is more than occasional worry. When it starts affecting your sleep, work, relationships, or daily routine, it deserves attention. Seeking help is a sign of strength.
Negative thoughts are normal, but when they become persistent and start affecting daily life, professional support can make a difference.
“You are not your thoughts.”
“Listen when teens struggle silently.”
“Help is available.”
“Your mind deserves care too.”
“Stress affects both mind and body.”

Mental health concerns such as anxiety, depression, stress, and sleep disturbances can affect daily life and overall well-being. Early psychiatric consultation can help identify concerns and guide appropriate treatment options.
If nighttime anxiety is keeping you awake, remember that you don't have to just "deal with it." It has a medical explanation, and more importantly, it can be treated.

Ever wonder why your mind waits until your head hits the pillow to remind you of everything you’ve ever worried about? 🧠💤
It’s not a personal weakness—it’s actually biology. During the day, the brain is flooded with external stimuli: work, conversations, scrolling, and daily noise. This constant "busyness" acts as a natural mute button for your brain's alarm system, the amygdala.
But when the lights go out and the room goes silent, the distractions disappear, and those suppressed fear signals get amplified.
If nighttime anxiety is keeping you awake, remember that you don't have to just "deal with it." It has a medical explanation, and more importantly, it can be treated.
👉 Follow us for more insights into mental health and brain biology.

featured_reviews.name: Vijay Bhosale
featured_reviews.review_text:
Must share my feedback about my one and only counselling session with Dr Zelam Patki. My wife and me had visited Dr Zelam Patki in year 2016. We as couple had issues in our (then) 5 years old marriage. Dr. Zelam Patki invited my wife first. I was waiting in the lobby for 20 minutes. I could hear my wife's crying and loud complaints from the room. After my wife's session, I was called in front of my wife. Dr. Zelam Patki was literally furious on me. She did not bother to ask me in private. She assumed all the allegations and complaints were true and it is her duty to school me. "Did you hit your wife?" I said no. "No you have no right to hit her". I said I don't believe in hitting anyone. I never did it. I am trying to be more gentleman, kept my calm. Without any counselling session with me, she started writing the medicines for me and my wife. My wife was sobbing for some time. Knowing my wife's condition, I started comforting her. But Madam Dr. Zelam did not. She made a statement to me in front of my wife that if I need a note from her for legal purposes, she is not going to give it. This was completely unwarranted. Nobody asked Dr. Zelam for that note. I looked at my wife. She started crying again. Dr. Zelam handed over the prescription and charged me handsomely. I really shot my arm by coming to such a unprofessional psychiatrist. It was so difficult to convince my wife that we had come to Dr. Zelam for the remedy and not for the legal note.

Year 2024, I am still in same marriage.   But this incident is still haunting me.I am still trying to understand why someone can be so unprofessional and biased. Of course, Dr. Zelam might have improved by now. But she really disturbed us more than doing any good.
